verses.gurmukhi: ਛੰਦ: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਅਗੋਚਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: chha(n)dh: aadh purakh paramaadh savaiaadh ras ga(n)dh agochar ||

en.bdb: Channt: Primordial Lord (God) has no beginning. He is beyond and still farther. He is free of such mundane worldly pleasures like taste, desires and fragrances.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਮਨੋਚਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas asaparas surat mat sabadh manochar ||

en.bdb: He is beyond vision, touch, reach of mind, intelligence and words.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਖੇ ਨਹੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit_en: log bedh gat giaan lakhe nahee alakh abhevaa ||

en.bdb: The imperceptible and unattached Lord cannot be known by study of Vedas and through other earthly knowledge.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit_en: net net kar namo namo nam satigur dhevaa ||8||

en.bdb: Satguru who is embodiment of Lord and inhabits His divine radiance is infinite. Thus, he is worthy of salutation and obeisance in all the three times-past, present and future. (8)
